messages:
rafael: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need firm owners & due dates for the 5 action items. Recommend a weekly 30m sync + a simple tracker. Who can own the tracker? cc @mina @lexi
mina: I can own the tracker for the next 2 sprints. I'll add a sheet and set reminders.
lexi: thanks. For cadence: weekly quick sync (15-30m) + monthly deep dive. IC rotation: propose 2-week IC shift, with 2–3 day overlap handoff note.
aaron: +1 on 2-week IC. Also suggest we add a 'recurrence' flag on action items for patterns so we can identify repeat offenders.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly follow-up in #eng-oncall every Mon 10:00 PST.
rafael: here's a quick timeline template I use, feel free to tweak:
```
- Day 0: Incident triage & RCA kickoff
- Day 1-3: Draft postmortem + immediate mitigations
- Day 7: Action items assigned with owners & due dates
- Week 2: First follow-up (status update)
- Week 4: Closure or escalate to program manager
- Month 1: Pattern review for recurring incidents
```
mina: I'll create the sheet with these columns: id, action, owner, due_date, status, recurrence, linked_pr, notes
lexi: can we add 'severity_impact' and 'rollback_plan' columns? will help prioritization.
mina: yep, adding those now.
aaron: For ownership rules: require owner + secondary + default SLA (2w). If overdue, auto-escalate to oncall lead and notify PM.
rafael: agree. Also add a short 'deferred_reason' field for items we choose to postpone.
lexi: I'll put together a 1-page playbook blurb for comms cadence (who emails execs, who updates customers, tempo of updates). Will post a draft in #eng-oncall by Tue.
mina: tracker created: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/placeholder (I'll share access)
rafael: great. Action summary: Mina -> create & share tracker (due today). Lexi -> comms blurb (due Tue). Aaron -> add recurrence tags + escalation rules in tracker (due Fri).
lexi: noted — will draft and then ping for review.
incident-bot: Action items added to tracker: Mina(1), Lexi(1), Aaron(1) :white_check_mark:
rafael: Thanks all. We'll review progress in the first weekly sync. If anyone wants to rotate IC sooner than their 2-week window, please flag here so we can adjust the rotation.
